name: Ritualistic Action
body:
The character knows special rituals for almost everything, and when he takes the time to perform them, they ensure that the gods smile upon him.

Benefit: Whenever the character takes 20 on a check, he can also perform a special ritual to ensure success. This grants him a +1 morale bonus to that check only; thus, when he takes 20, it becomes 21.
